title: Arcane Velocity
summary: Arcane Velocity is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 90% chance, whenever the player achieves a Critical Hit, to increase Fire Rate on Secondaries for 9 seconds.
extract:
Arcane Velocity is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 90% chance, whenever the player achieves a Critical Hit, to increase Fire Rate on Secondaries for 9 seconds.
Can be sold for  500.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for killing or capturing the Eidolon Hydrolyst.
Dropped in Rotation C of Orphix Pluto Proxima or Veil Proxima missions.
Sometimes offered as weekly rewards for completing Infernums in The Descendia.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

History
Arcane Velocity was first introduced in the Trial mission The Jordas Verdict, which was retired in Update 22.14 (2018-03-01).
The Operation: Scarlet Spear event sold Arcane Velocity from Little Duck for 1,500  Scarlet Credits.
The Operation: Orphix Venom event sold Arcane Velocity from Father for 300  Phasic Cells.
The Operation: Gargoyle's Cry event sold Arcane Velocity from the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle for 5  Grotesque Splinter.
The Operation: Belly of the Beast event sold Arcane Velocity from Ordis for 3  Volatile Motes in the first run of the event, and 4 Motes in the second, with a purchase limit of 42.
The Operation: Eight Claw event sold Arcane Velocity from Dominus Thrax in bundles of 7, costing 2  Dominus Aureus, with a purchase limit of 3 (21 Arcanes in total).

Notes
Stacks additively with fire rate from mods such as  Gunslinger.
Can be triggered by critical hits from almost any source, including all weapon types, beast and sentinel attacks, and even Warframe abilities (such as  Wisp's  Breach Surge sparks and all of  Gyre's damaging abilities).
This arcane works with the  Regulators, the  Dex Pixia, the  Balefire Charger, the  Noctua, and the  Glory,  along with any Primed counterparts.
